# UF Sports Performance Center

> The University of Florida Sports Performance Center provides advanced 3D motion analysis, biomechanics research, injury prevention, and athlete training services through the UF Department of Orthopaedic Surgery and Sports Medicine.

UF SPC combines cutting-edge motion capture technology with clinical expertise to serve athletes, patients, and researchers. The center specializes in return-to-sport assessments, swing analysis, strength testing, and evidence-based training programs led by experienced faculty, athletic trainers, and biomechanics specialists.

## Key Topics

- 3D motion analysis
- Biomechanics
- Sports performance
- Injury prevention
- Athletic training
- Return-to-sport
- UF Department of Orthopaedic Surgery and Sports Medicine
- Clinical research
- Swing analysis
- Sports medicine
- Injury rehabilitation
- Motion capture
- Strength testing
- UF Health Orthopedics and Sports Medicine Institute
